documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results
Board Meeting Outcome for Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a 27% year-on-year revenue growth for Q1 FY27, with the construction equipment segment contributing 45% of total revenue. Management expects FY27 growth to exceed FY26 levels, supported by a robust new business order book of over INR 225 crores. While the large agricultural equipment market is currently at a cyclical bottom, the company anticipates a recovery in 2027 and is expanding its global footprint with new warehouse operations in Mexico starting in Q3. Uniparts India reported a 27% year-on-year revenue growth for Q1 FY27, with EBITDA and PAT growing by 55% and 64% respectively. Management noted that the restoration of the Ludhiana facility is on schedule and Mexico operations are progressing toward first deliveries in Q3.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 revenue growth to be higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates Q2 FY27 performance to be consistent with the first quarter.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: The company's Q1 FY27 performance exceeded its previously shared annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects its growth in FY27 to be in line with its FY26 growth performance.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 performance to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26, with H2 FY27 stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to operate comfortably above a 20% EBITDA margin level as volumes expand through FY27.
guidance.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

demand_outlook.claim: The construction equipment segment has maintained growth momentum into the first quarter of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management views 2026 as the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment with recovery expected in 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment demand in India is performing well due to government subsidies and adoption of higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket segment is expected to normalize and return to growth as tariffs have decreased.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalize and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure spending in the US and Europe is supporting healthy order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture segment in India is performing well due to government subsidies and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agriculture market conditions are currently subdued, with a recovery anticipated in CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket demand was affected by price volatility driven by tariffs.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment demand in North America is expected to continue growing in FY27, with strengthening through the year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The North American small agriculture equipment segment is expected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry volumes for large tractors in North America continue to decline in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in the third quarter of the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for Q1 FY27 was INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are progressing with warehouse deliveries expected to begin in the third quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is continuing to invest in its construction and large agricultural equipment businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: We are continuing to invest in growing our construction and large agricultural equipment businesses, given that small ag is already a segment where we hold significant global market share.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts plans to keep its capex within 2.5% to 3.5% of its revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for the fourth quarter of FY26 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter grew by 55% year-on-year to INR 90 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter stood at 33.3% due to changes in the product mix.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Warehouse-led sales represent the company's highest margin delivery channel.
margins_costs.quote: And then the warehouse sales is our highest margin product.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical issues in West Asia are impacting supply chains and input costs.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 25.3% in the first quarter of FY27.
The gross profit margin for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, was 66.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6% 64.7% 65.6%

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts recorded an EBITDA margin of 24% for Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability in FY26 was impacted by INR 3.4 crores owing to the implementation of the new wage code in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book is valued at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The construction equipment business currently accounts for 45% of total revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Aftermarket business contributed approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's new business order book for the trailing twelve months exceeds INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month annualized business wins surpassed INR 225 crores, representing quarter-on-quarter growth of over 12.5%.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is actively evaluating approximately half a dozen acquisition opportunities.
capital_allocation.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: So the capital requirement of 2.5% to 3.5% is the capital requirements for fresh equipment and repairs and maintenance for the organic business. For the inorganic business today, we are a debt-free balance sheet with roughly INR190 crores of cash on hand.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the first quarter with a net cash position of INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is actively looking for acquisition opportunities to support strategic growth.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts distributed a total dividend of INR 170 crores in FY26, including a special dividend of INR 101 crores declared in Q3 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts maintains a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026 and remains net debt-free.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia situation is impacting input costs and supply chain stability.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: The large agricultural equipment industry is expected to decline by mid-teens in the current year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility has previously caused customers to moderate aftermarket purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Economic uncertainty has caused consumers to delay purchases of big-ticket equipment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred in the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility towards the end of Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fresh geopolitical escalations in West Asia during March created supply chain uncertainty and increased input prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected to commence.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: The fabrication vertical is expected to become a meaningful part of the business.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: FY27 revenue growth is projected to exceed the growth rate of FY26.
management_commitments.quote: our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to begin first customer deliveries from its Mexico warehouse in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to build on its structural new business momentum.
management_commitments.quote: The new business momentum is structural, and we intend to build on it.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects growth in FY27 to match the growth rate achieved in FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 sequentially to match Q4 FY26 and H2 FY27 to outperform H1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts plans to maintain its capex intensity within 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
